reviewed_pages.speaker: George
without_exact_registration: [NPC] George: A hobby that's not as easy for me as it is for a skilled tamer like yourself.
[NPC] George: Ah, a seasoned tamer, I see! Welcome!
[NPC] George: Ah, the Rift is a place of mystery, one I've longed to explore but alas, have never had the chance.
[NPC] George: Bring me this creature from beyond, and let's advance your taming prowess together!
[NPC] George: Do you think the Epic Jellyfish can dance?
[NPC] George: For each rare pet you bring to me, starting with the elusive Epic Rift Ferret, I'll unlock an additional level in your Taming skill.
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Baby Yeti yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Bal yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Giraffe yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Jellyfish yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Rift Ferret yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Slug yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Epic Spirit yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Legendary Black Cat yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Mythic Enderman yet?
[NPC] George: Have you found the Rare Frost Wisp yet?
[NPC] George: I cannot stand the cold!
[NPC] George: I'm curious to see if they really are as tall as the legends say.
[NPC] George: I'm glad you could fetch me a Epic Baby Yeti?
[NPC] George: I've always been fascinated by their mysterious charm.
[NPC] George: I've always been mesmerized by their underwater ballet.
[NPC] George: I've always wanted a Epic Giraffe?
[NPC] George: In exchange for your help in expanding my collection, I offer a unique opportunity.
[NPC] George: Is that a Epic Spirit?
[NPC] George: It's a bit too hot for me down there!
[NPC] George: May your adventures continue to be as fruitful and exciting as this quest has been!
[NPC] George: My garden seems to miss having one around!
[NPC] George: Now, I am be delighted to see a Rare Frost Wisp.
[NPC] George: Oh yes, an Epic Slug.
[NPC] George: Remember, the world of taming is vast and ever-changing.
[NPC] George: Shhhh. Don't disturb the Legendary Black Cat.
[NPC] George: Thank you for bringing me the Mythic Enderman.
[NPC] George: Thank you for getting the Epic Bal.
[NPC] George: Their enigmatic presence and otherworldly aura have always captivated me.
[NPC] George: Their icy presence is said to be quite refreshing.
[NPC] George: Their mysterious aura has always intrigued me.
[NPC] George: Why the Rift Ferret you ask?
[NPC] George: You see, I have a penchant for collecting exotic pets.
[NPC] George: You've brought me all the pets I've asked for, and in doing so, have shown exceptional dedication and skill.
[NPC] George: You've done it!
[NPC] George: You've mastered the art of Taming to level 50, a commendable feat.
[NPC] George: You've not only helped me complete my collection but also demonstrated the true spirit of a master tamer.
[NPC] George: Your Taming level cap can now reach the maximum level of 60, thanks to your efforts.
